_comment: Owner: contract-architect (wave 0c). Frozen together with contracts/.
These are the golden fixtures every agent tests against. Files whose name
starts with an underscore are metadata, not fixtures. Files directly in
this directory are report DEFINITIONS and must pass
contracts.validate_definition(). Files in portable/ are export ENVELOPES
and must pass contracts.validate_portable_document(). Files in invalid/
None of the valid fixtures contains an ORM path, a lookup or anything else
the query compiler could take literally. They only contain registry keys.
That is deliberate: a golden fixture doubles as a demonstration of what a
stored definition may legitimately look like.

minimal_order.json.purpose: Smallest document that validates: one column, everything else defaulted. Use it to check that optional members really are optional.

wide_order.json.purpose: 31 columns across every group, all three format families, a label override, a hidden column. The performance and rendering workhorse.

order_with_aggregates.json.purpose: SPEC.md F3: position-level data on an order-based report. Covers count, sum, min, max, avg, count_distinct and join, including the same field used four times with different aggregates.

orderposition_basic.json.purpose: The classic attendee list: order data, position data, product, variation, subevent, seat, voucher.

orderposition_questions.json.purpose: Question fields (answer.<identifier>) as columns, filters and sorting. The portability case: these keys may stop resolving.

relative_date_filters.json.purpose: All six relative date operators. Essential for scheduled exports (SPEC.md F6/F8) -- these are the filters that must keep making sense on every run.

filters_and_or.json.purpose: AND across groups, OR inside a group -- the exact nesting SPEC.md F6 allows, and no more.

multi_level_sorting.json.purpose: Five sorting stages in a defined order (SPEC.md F7).

plugin_and_meta_fields.json.purpose: Third-party plugin namespace (SPEC.md F5) and event meta properties. Needs the stub registry or a real plugin providing plugin.pretix_demo.demo_value.

options_full.json.purpose: Every option set to a non-default value, including row_limit and canceled positions.

portable/report_export.json.purpose: Import/export file format (SPEC.md F9): envelope metadata plus an inner definition. 'meta' is free-form and owned by portability-dev.

_comment: Every key used by a valid fixture. The real registry MUST provide these
under exactly these names, otherwise the shared fixtures stop being
shared. Adding fields is free; renaming one of these is a contract

questions._comment: Present only if the event has a question with this identifier. Test factories should create exactly these.

meta_properties._comment: Event meta property names, present only if the organizer defines them.

plugin._comment: Stub only. No real plugin is expected to provide this; the fixture exists so the plugin namespace is exercised end to end.

_comment: What the registry must arrange so that the valid fixtures compile.

order.not_sortable: everything that requires an aggregate on this base
